import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
d = df.dropna(subset=['recovery_score']).copy()
for e in exposures:
    dd = d.dropna(subset=[e])
    m = smf.ols(f"recovery_score ~ {e} + C(hospital)", data=dd).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={m.params[e]: .4f}  se={m.bse[e]:.4f}  t={m.tvalues[e]: .2f}  p={m.pvalues[e]:.4f}  n={int(m.nobs)}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['recovery_score']).copy()
# steps_k detail
dd = d.dropna(subset=['steps_k'])
print(dd['steps_k'].describe())
m = smf.ols("recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)", data=dd).fit()
print(m.summary().tables[1])
# check missingness of steps_k by hospital
print("\nsteps_k missing by hospital:")
print(df.assign(miss=df['steps_k'].isna()).groupby('hospital')['miss'].mean())
# recovery vs steps_k within hospital
for h in ['H1','H2','H3','H4']:
    sub = dd[dd.hospital==h]
    print(h, "corr", round(sub['steps_k'].corr(sub['recovery_score']),3), "n", len(sub))
